Bataille, C., Stiebert, S. and Li, F.G.N. (2021). Global facility level net-zero steel pathways: technical report on the first scenarios of the Net-zero Steel Project. IDDRI, Paris, 11 October 2021. http://netzerosteel.org

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 2). A global facility-level scenario model (Steelpath) report: the only per-technology numbers are Table 4 (p.27): investment cycle 25 yr, direct emission intensity (t CO2e/t crude steel) and energy intensity (GJ/t) for whole routes (EAF, OHF, BF-BOF, BF-BOF-CCS, DRI-EAF coal, gas, gas+CCS, H2), plus availability years and TRLs from Sect. 2.3. All are whole-route values per t crude steel at an integrated-facility boundary (scope 1 incl. on-site power, no credits); energy intensity excludes off-site electricity (EAF and DRI-EAF-H2 show 0.22 GJ/t). Traps: DRI-EAF-H2 values are identical to scrap EAF (0.115 t/t, 0.22 GJ/t); H2-DRI availability 2027 in Table 4 but 2028 on p.26/p.29; last unabated BF-BOF year 2024 vs 2025. All costs (Fig. 8, 12, 13) are bar charts with no printed values and are not extracted (USD 2020 per t crude steel). Not loaded: country results, scrap forecasts (Table 2), facility counts (other-values only).
